players.product: PCIe Gen6 switches and retimers, timing, Ethernet PHYs and optical-module connectivity

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1): capital expenditures for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 are expected to be between $20 million and $25 million, and approximately $100 million for all of fiscal 2027. Microchip has paused most of its factory expansion actions and reduced planned capital investments through fiscal 2027, but is adding capital equipment to selectively expand production capacity and add research and development equipment. CEO Steve Sanghi: PCIe Gen6 connectivity design wins doubled sequentially from six programs at the end of the March quarter to 12 programs exiting the June quarter, reflecting growing momentum in data center and connectivity applications.
quarterly_data.figure: Sept-quarter capex $20 million-$25 million; fiscal 2027 capex ~$100 million; PCIe Gen6 design wins 6 -> 12 programs
